_comment: Vertical-stack region 1 of 3: outdoor selva wood + colle plateau + chapel exterior (facade, walls, plinth, roof). Player enters chapel_interior via the chapel-door trigger; player descends from chapel_interior into limbo via the descent-bottom trigger. All three regions are RESIDENT in physics + render at all times (multi-resident architecture per [[feedback_seamless_world_traversal]]) so the player can see across seams.

static_meshes._comment: Lonza's half-eaten carcass at Lupa's feet (per the wolf-lore lock + Capitoline-inversion framing -- she's been devouring her own kind, the last apex predators of the pre-failure Wood). Husky-as-stand-in, generated by gen_dead_lonza.py: head/neck removed, back half + tail gone, front-left paw missing. After pose-as-rest from the Death animation's final frame, the body lies flat (its geometry centered around X=+1.36 in mesh-local space, so world_origin.x=-1.36 brings the visible center to X=0 under Lupa). Trimesh collision is automatic (surface_tag=Architecture) so the player can't walk through it. Placed 1m IN FRONT of Lupa: she's at Z=-200 facing +Z (yaw=pi means facing north, toward higher Z), so 'in front' = higher Z. Carcass center at Z=-199 = 1m forward of Lupa, so she's leaning OVER it as she eats.

terrain_modifiers._comment: Chapel exterior plateau. Terrain depresses to plinth-bottom Y (kChapelGroundY 22.3 - kPlinthHeight 0.30 = 22.0) around the chapel footprint, extended forward by the door-threshold ramp length (0.50m) so terrain covers under the ramp. Soft 2m blend on -X/+X/-Z, SHARP +Z edge at the threshold OUTER face (-205.5). See [[feedback_structures_own_terrain_seam]].

Corridor wedge FlushSlope. Terrain follows the descent corridor's ceiling roof down for ~7.74m past the chapel back wall (Z=-214 to Z=-221.74) so the gap between chapel back and natural terrain is filled by terrain sloping along the corridor roof. value at -Z edge (far_z=-221.74), value_far at +Z edge (near_z=-214, chapel back wall). Slope = kStairRise/kStairTread = 0.4571 per m.

triggers._comment: Stepping onto the chapel-door threshold ramp from outside fires this trigger. transition_mode Instant + preserve_player_pos true: the player's world coords are valid in both surface and chapel_interior (one continuous world), so we don't teleport -- we just swap the current region for trigger-context purposes. Multi-resident architecture means the chapel_interior mesh was already drawn this frame; the player visually walks right through.

Boss-engage trigger for Lupa (per docs/design/ideas/boss_backend.md Pattern B). She boot-spawns at Z=-200 (a few meters from the chapel front at Z=-205.5, sitting on the natural colle terrain rather than the chapel plateau). Trigger is a proximity ring CENTERED ON HER. Y range generous because actor float Y on this colle terrain varies. action=Custom + action_payload=engage:lupa routes to BossDispatcher::handleEngageVerb, which clears current_boss_state, forces awareness to Combat, plays engage_clip (jump_to_idle).

doors._comment: Chapel front door. Locked at game start so the player can't escape into the chapel during the Lupa fight. Opens via a scripted-event watcher when 'lupa_felled' OR 'vagrant_rescued' flag is set (the Guide emerges and the door opens regardless of outcome). Once Open, terminal -- the chapel is permanently accessible thereafter. World position: chapel front face at Z=-205.5, door cutout centered on X=0, plateau Y=22.0. Hinge on the -X edge (door pivots inward, away from approaching player). Yaw=0 means the door's swinging edge points +X when closed; rotation pivots it toward +Z (inward, into the chapel) when opening.

enemy_spawns._comment: Lupa, lone surviving legend of the pre-failure Wood (per [[selva-wood-lore-locked-2026-05-31]]; story.md Beat 2 opening boss). Pattern B already-there boss: boot-spawns into her sitting/sad pose (archetype.initial_state=sitting + idle_clip=idle_2_head_low). Positioned ~5.5m north of the chapel front (door at Z=-205.5, Lupa at Z=-200) on the natural colle terrain in front of the chapel -- not on the plateau itself, blocking the approach rather than lounging on the doorstep. Facing +Z (yaw=pi=3.14159, looking back toward the player's approach). permanent_on_death true -- save-persistent, monument-of-the-empty-chapel-front per the lore lock. pos.y auto_terrain samples the natural heightmap at her XZ.
enemy_spawns._arena_note: Arena lockout AABB centered FORWARD of Lupa (Z=-200, in front of her at Z=-204) with bigger Z extent (16m) so the player approach side has room to dance + circle. X half-extent 18m gives full plateau width. North boundary Z=-184 (16m forward of Lupa); south boundary Z=-216 (clips just past chapel back at Z=-214). Per boss_backend.md section 7 lockout AABB.

_territory_note: Single territory volume covering the entire selva surface (wood + colle plateau + chapel exterior). Large XZ extent + tall Y range. chapel_interior's chapel-building volume sits nested inside; smallest-wins gives chapel positions to chapel_interior.

territory._comment: Surface region territory. Conservative AABB covering the playable wood + chapel plateau zone.
